title: anthyllis vulneraria var. rubriflora
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria var. rubriflora, commonly known as red kidney vetch or red clover, is a plant species in the pea family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in wound healing and soothing irritated skin. The therapeutic actions of red kidney vetch include its vasodilatory properties, which may help to improve blood circulation and reduce blood pressure, as well as its antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
